narrative: Paid my credit card at 11:58pm on the due date, September 5, through the app. I know that's cutting it close but the app accepted it and showed it as paid on the 5th. I still got a $40 late fee and a notice that my APR could go up. Two minutes!

My county property tax bill was supposed to be paid from my escrow account by September 1. I just got a delinquency notice from the county with a $212 penalty. I pay into escrow every single month. The Bank says the payment went to the wrong parcel number and they are looking into it.

I financed a used truck through the Bank in July. I was told I would get a welcome packet with how to make payments. Never got anything, the online account was never set up, and now there is a 30 day late on my credit report for a loan I didn't know how to pay.

The ATM at the Main St branch didn't give me any cash on September 9 but took $200 out of my checking. I filed a claim at the branch the same day. Got a letter saying the ATM balanced and my claim is denied. There is a camera right there, check it!!

A debt collector working for the Bank called my neighbor and told her I owe money and asked her to give me the message. My neighbor is 82 and now the whole street knows my business. I never gave anyone her number. This is humiliating.

I am writing about my mother's checking and savings accounts and I am going to try to put everything in order, because I have told this story to at least nine different people at the Bank. My mother is a widow and has banked with you for over 30 years. She has power of attorney paperwork on file naming me, which the Bank accepted in 2023. In late July my mother got a phone call from someone who said they were from a computer company and that her computer had a virus. Over about two weeks they talked her into moving money around. On August 6 she went to the branch and tried to wire $18,000 to an account overseas. The teller, who I would like to thank by name if anyone will let me, refused to send it and called me. That teller probably saved my mother's life savings. I came down to the branch that same afternoon. We met with the branch manager, who agreed it looked like a scam and said they would put a temporary hold on the accounts to protect her while the fraud team reviewed it. He said it would be a few days. We agreed to that. It was the right thing to do at the time. That was August 6. It is now the middle of September and the accounts are still frozen, all of them, including the checking account her Social Security goes into. My mother cannot pay her electric bill, her supplemental insurance, or her pharmacy. I have been paying them out of my own pocket, about $1,400 so far, and I am not wealthy. I have called the fraud department eleven times. I have a log. Every time, they tell me the case is still under review and that they cannot give a timeline. Twice they told me someone would call me back within 48 hours. Nobody called. On August 28 a fraud specialist told me the hold would be released as soon as my mother came in with two forms of ID and signed an affidavit. We did that on August 30 at the branch. On September 4 someone else in fraud told me there was no record of the affidavit and we had to do it again. We did it again on September 6. I asked the branch to scan it while I watched and they did. On September 11 I was told the case had been escalated but nobody could tell me to whom. I understand that the Bank has to be careful. I really do. I am grateful the wire was stopped. But at some point protecting my mother turned into keeping her from her own money. The scammers never got a dime, because your teller stopped them. The only person losing anything now is my mother, and me. She is embarrassed and confused and keeps asking me if she did something illegal. She did not. I have asked whether the Bank could at least release her monthly deposits, or open a new account for her with new numbers so her benefits can go somewhere she can use them. I was told that was not possible while the review was open, but nobody could tell me what policy says so. What I am asking for is simple. Please give my mother access to her money, or at the very least her monthly income, and give me a real person and a real phone number for whoever is handling this. If there is something else you need from us, tell us and we will bring it the same day. We have done everything we have been asked, twice. She should not have to spend her retirement fighting with her own bank over money she spent her whole life saving. I am attaching copies of the POA, both affidavits, and my call log. Thank you.
